# cortexcloud_biocs (Data Source)

Lists Behavioral Indicators of Compromise (BIOCs) matching an optional filter set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Optional filter clauses. Omit for an unfiltered listing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `biocs` (Attributes List) The BIOCs returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--biocs))
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier (constant `biocs`).

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `field` (String) Filter field (e.g. `name`, `type`, `severity`, `is_xql`, `rule_id`).
- `operator` (String) Filter operator (`EQ`, `NEQ`, `IN`, `GTE`, `LTE`).
- `value` (String) Filter value, serialized as the API `value` field. Numeric fields (`rule_id`) and the boolean `is_xql` field are coerced from the string form before submission.
